credits.wathe.thank_you:
I have long observed things through my own point of view. But that is only seeing with one eye.
If you never accept viewpoints other than your own, if you never add more eyes, you cannot observe the truth in three dimensions.
That is my explanation of “without love, it cannot be seen.”
...Without love, it cannot be seen? .......Ha. It is the other way around.
It is because there is love that we see things which do not exist at all.
......It is a mere illusion: visible only to yourself, yet beyond even your own touch.
If only there were no love, humanity would be spared from seeing any truth or falsehood.
And it is precisely because we see truth and falsehood....... that we are bewildered. That we suffer. That we cry out.
- Umineko no Naku Koro ni
 - RAT / doctor4t
